name: Frigorific-Cirque
description: Grass-plains and basalt shields alternate across the habitable belt, stitched together by magnetic pole anomalies. Farther poleward, past tectonic rift valleys, the silence feels older than the soil.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
The next expedition is already fitting out. Whether it returns with data, ore, or just debts depends on choices nobody has made yet.
